correction_of_first_pass: The first blanket scan incorrectly treated full-pool shard planning manifests as prior use. They list all1096 FinQA records and are inventory only, not evidence of API use or per-question review. The first zero-eligible result is invalid for real-use freshness.

definitions.L1: Sample-bound API request/response/usage/error/prediction records under known real backend run roots; source snapshots, caches, offline/replay/mock/test and full-pool planning excluded. Prior cache-backed API-mode predictions remain conservative exposure because those exact questions were used in model development; no claim every round made a fresh request.
definitions.L2: Specific small-validation selections, per-question debug/review records and benchmark text/ID examples in prompts/tests/scripts. Full-pool retained_ids inventories are excluded. Includes concrete offline replays of already inspected cases as development exposure, without claiming API sends.
definitions.L3: Only normalized full-context overlap propagated from L1 or L2 to otherwise unreferenced main IDs.
definitions.L4: Pure planning inventories/full-pool lists, cached opaque responses, source snapshots or offline-only pool artifacts. These do not themselves exclude questions.
